issues.span: दुर्बल होकर पतन को प्राप्त होता है
issues.evidence: Tibetan 'བཟེ་རེ་ཅན་གྱུར་ཉིད་དུ་ལྟུང་' = falls into the state of being 'bzer re can' (fragile/intolerant); bo-shenga glosses it as unable to bear even slight suffering (སྡུག་བསྔལ་ཕྲ་མོ་ཙམ་ཡང་བཟོད་པར་མི་ནུས་པ་ཉིད་དུ་ལྷུང་), bo-gyaltsab similarly. 'दुर्बल' (weak) misses the delicacy/intolerance sense (Skt sukumāratara), and 'दुर्बल होकर ... पतन' recasts the fall-into-a-state as weakening then falling.
issues.fix: अत्यन्त सुकुमार (असहिष्णु) अवस्था में जा गिरता है

issues.evidence: Tibetan 'བསམ་པ་ཉམས་པ' = deterioration/loss of intention; bo-gyaltsab: དགེ་བའི་ཕྱོགས་ཀྱི་བསམ་པ་ཉམས་པ (wholesome intention declines) and bo-shenga: བསམ་པ་ཉམས་པ; Skt āśābhaṅga (disappointment). 'दूषित' means corrupted/defiled, not decayed or lost.

Tibetan 'བདག་གིས་མཉམ་པར་གཞག་པར་བྱ' with 'སེམས་བླན་ཏེ' (withdrawing the mind) and Skt 'cittam ... svālambana-nirantaram': the mind is the object placed in equipoise. The Hindi verb 'समाहित करूँगा' has no object and is ungrammatical/unclear.
